verdict.rationale: Bento documents plain-English input for specific features: you can describe failure modes in plain English to train signals, and write alerts in natural language that compile to trace queries. Its Agent Skills also hand a coding agent the integration playbook. Broader natural-language operation of the product, such as triage, querying runs or analytics, is not documented; those tasks are exposed through the dashboard and CLI. missing for 10: general natural-language command interface across product operations, documented agent-driven operation beyond integration setup, independent/hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Describe any failure mode in plain English — Bento trains a signal on your own traces, fires it in real time, and backfills your entire history
Alerts are defined in plain natural language... Rules compile to trace queries and route to Slack, PagerDuty, email, or webhook.
It installs Bento’s Agent Skills and hands the agent the full integration playbook
